answer: Plume weighting: each account earns a plume only via two bonded vouches from lagoon-status accounts, whose stake unlocks after 90 days. Accounts with under two vouches carry zero voting weight in the oasis registry. To forge 1,000 voters, an attacker must lock 1,000 deposits and corrupt 1,000 aging vouches, paying full bond plus 90-day decay per sybil.
